title: Back of the tongue: /k/ and /g/
goal: Practise /k/ and /g/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Raise the back of your tongue to the soft part of the roof of your mouth, then release. Do not push your tongue against your front teeth.
spelling: k and hard c can represent /k/; g in goat represents /g/. These letters have other patterns too.
task: Ask where your coat is. Answer with a short place phrase.
story: A goat is by the gate. A cat is on the grass.
reviewPrompt: Return to day 5, 12, 16, 18. Recall a word or say one useful phrase before opening those lessons.

articulation.label: cat
articulation.alt: cat: /k/ → /æ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: a piece of clothing worn over other clothes outside. Mia takes her coat and hat.

a road vehicle for a few people. The car is outside the house.
a small container for a drink often with a handle. Puck's tea is in a cup.
prepare food using heat. Mia cooks dinner in the evening.
